finalResult.nextParagraphText: “True Ancestor... the answer remains no and will always be no,” the Sword Saint said, leaving no room for discussion. However, for good measure, he did momentarily flare his aura as a Transcendent. Fairleigh and the True Ancestor both weren’t Transcendents and thus couldn’t passively sense he had one, but at least Miyamoto had learned to purposefully display his status when he so desired.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I see,” the Sword Saint nodded before sighing. “And yet the answer remains no... for it still does not suit my Path.”
